headline: Tk 16.25 crore gold seized: 80 gold bars found in shoes of airline staff
summary: Customs intelligence officials recovered 9.34kg of gold from the shoes of two airline employees arriving from Dubai at Dhaka airport.
details: Customs intelligence officials recovered 80 gold bars weighing approximately 9.34kg from the shoes of two airline staff members at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka today.
Acting on a tip-off, the Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate (CIID) intercepted the two staff members as they arrived on Emirates Airlines flight EK0582 from Dubai.
Each gold bar weighed around 117 grammes, with the total estimated market value of the seized gold being around Tk 16.25 crore.
The gold bars were allegedly concealed inside the shoes using a special method to evade customs checks.
The CIID is currently investigating the origin of the gold, the intended recipient, and other individuals involved in the smuggling attempt.
caption:
9.34kg of gold hidden in shoes! Customs officials seize Tk 16.25 crore worth of gold bars from airline staff at Dhaka airport.

Customs intelligence officials recovered 80 gold bars weighing approximately 9.34kg from the shoes of two airline staff members at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka today.

Acting on a tip-off, the Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate (CIID) intercepted the two staff members as they arrived on Emirates Airlines flight EK0582 from Dubai.

Each gold bar weighed around 117 grammes, with the total estimated market value of the seized gold being around Tk 16.25 crore.

The gold bars were allegedly concealed inside the shoes using a special method to evade customs checks.

The CIID is currently investigating the origin of the gold, the intended recipient, and other individuals involved in the smuggling attempt.

headline: Regional Communist Party leader shot dead in Khulna
summary: Md. Nasimul Karim was killed by gunmen in front of his home in Dighalia Upazila.
details: Md. Nasimul Karim, also known as Nasim, was shot dead by gunmen in front of his home in Formaiskhana village, Dighalia Upazila of Khulna.
Witnesses said that while Nasim was having tea in front of his house, two men arrived in a van and shot him before fleeing the scene.
He was rushed to Khulna Medical College Hospital, where the duty doctor declared him dead.
Dighalia Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Khandakar Sanowar Hussain Masum stated that three empty shells and three live bullets were recovered from the scene.
The police have not yet confirmed the motive behind the killing or the identity of the attackers.
Law enforcement agencies are currently working to identify and arrest those involved in the murder.
caption:

He was rushed to Khulna Medical College Hospital, where the duty doctor declared him dead.

Dighalia Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Khandakar Sanowar Hussain Masum stated that three empty shells and three live bullets were recovered from the scene.

The police have not yet confirmed the motive behind the killing or the identity of the attackers.

Law enforcement agencies are currently working to identify and arrest those involved in the murder.
